question: In the freeway or expressway lane-ends sequence in Figure 2C-13, which symbol sign is shown nearest the beginning of the lane-reduction taper?
model_answer: Direct Answer: In panel A of Figure 2C-13 (Sheet 1 of 5), "Freeway or expressway - lane ends," the symbol sign shown nearest the beginning of the lane-reduction taper is the Lane Ends (W4-2R) symbol sign. It is placed at the advance placement distance from the taper determined from Table 2C-3, while the optional word-legend RIGHT LANE ENDS (W9-1R) sign with a 1000 FEET (W16-2P) plaque is located farther upstream. Guidance (recommended): - "The Lane Ends (W4-2) sign should be installed at the advance placement distance in accordance with Table 2C-3." Options (permitted): - "Where a lane ends a distance beyond the intersection that is less than the advance placement distance indicated in Table 2C-3, the W4-2 sign may be located at the far side of the intersection (see Sheet 4 of Figure 2C-13)." Visual evidence: [Image 1] shows the freeway/expressway lane-ends sequence with the W4-2R symbol sign as the closest sign to the taper (with the dimension line to Table 2C-3's advance placement distance) and the W9-1R/W16-2P assembly upstream. [Image 2] is the full-page view of the same Sheet 1 of Figure 2C-13, confirming the W4-2R is nearest the taper. [Image 5] (Sheet 3 of 5) shows the analogous left-lane arrangements using the W4-2L symbol nearest the taper. [Image 3] (Sheet 5 of 5) shows a different condition (two lanes merging to one) using the W4-8 sign, distinguishing it from the freeway lane-ends case. [Image 4] (Figure 3B-14) likewise depicts the W4-2R sign placed at the advance placement distance (AP) from the lane-reduction taper. Citations: - Figure 2C-13 (p.185) - Section 2C.47 Guidance §3 (p.186) - Section 2C.47 Option §7 (p.186) - Page 226 - Page 228 - Page 230 - Page 608
gold_answer: The W4-2R Lane Ends symbol sign.
